title: Conditional κ = 0.001600848528154892: four-provider joint-prefix packing
body:
Conditional **κ = 0.001600848528154892**, **0.01037836% above #571**. The complex supplier binds at **b = 0.001603415353263184744465**. The conservative complex model separately admits κ = **0.001600848525369710**; the unchanged cited #543 bit supplier remains nonbinding with its surcharge retained.

This selects among four verified local suppliers within one newly reconstructed literal owner allocation: **58 joint-prefix width-seven eight-cold calls, eight width-seven eight-cold calls, four plain eight-cold calls and two plain four-cold calls**. The scalar words come from #571, #572/#568 and #569. The new contribution is their joint selection, exact owner expansion and complete admission; no predecessor gains are added.

```
H = {1:169296, 2:41043, 3:25943, 4:13824,
     5:4032, 6:4032, 7:3, 8:576, 48:1817}
```

Dimension 73, live stock 7168, physical stock 7682, rank mass 520704 and deficit 2560. The assignment checks all 36,288 helper roles, 6,222 actual charts and 3,038 positive idle remainders. A pattern/time flow model produces literal bins through exact bipartite matching. The solver stopped with a feasible nomination at its time limit; no solver or packing optimality claim is used.

Package: `research/mixed-prefix-fourway`. Python standard library only:

```sh
python3 -B research/mixed-prefix-fourway/verify.py --work /absolute/new/fourway
```

The cold verifier rebuilds the complete pinned #572/#568 chain, then reconstructs the #569 plain four-cold supplier and #571 joint-prefix supplier. All four local providers are freshly verified before the new owners and invoice. Checks include both 728-column orientations, arbitrary dirty restoration, exact frames, normalized wrappers, complete phases/endpoints, kernel omissions, 16 owner mutations, a complete finite invoice, two rational moment engines, both complex models, seven bootstrap levels and 47 strict outer conditions per model. All 109 assembly mutations, four timing accept/reject pairs, four actual recompressions and 72 proof/reference mutations are checked. Every proof-relevant provider field is frozen; generated gzip equality uses exact decompressed content.

Final frozen-source cold replay passed on **macOS/Python 3.14.8 in 541.075 s** and **Linux/Python 3.12.3 in 607.330 s**, each with 30 top-level stages and the complete nested dependency replay. Results are byte-identical; all 28 proof-content identities and every numerical/semantic invoice field agree. Receipts and full provenance are in `research/mixed-prefix-fourway-validation`. The unchanged repository baseline reuses PR572’s published 18-group passing evidence, including `gen4-bank-verify`; it is not claimed as a new aggregate execution. The initial packaging-path failure and final fresh reruns are documented.

Concurrent #574 (`f3e0af901f88f2fd3a213224ad3b59a16b5f4688`) admits κ = 0.00160073442456167 (independently replayed all 24 stages in 237.3 s) by upgrading #571's nine plain calls and repacking. This four-provider construction is higher. #574's owner map is not used here. Concurrent #575 (`eac6f7e378ab622dac50a2fd4b7ef6eab014de44`) reports κ = 0.001600770286423653 using joint prefixes in all 72 calls. Its full 39-stage independent replay passed in 300.912 s; its rate is also below this construction. No #575 source is used here.

Concurrent #576 (`269490b0553e59bf224ab96009809ae8908d8f74`), discovered at publication, reports the higher κ = 0.001600951400768614 using 12 further cold kernels and a new three-provider allocation. Its independent replay is pending. This PR does not incorporate those new kernels and does not claim the strongest reported frontier; its contribution is the four-provider packing and fully reproduced admission described above.

Attribution: Dominik Scholz (`DominikScholz`, #571/#569) supplies the joint prefix, width-seven promotions and four-cold provider; Jeremy Kothe (`jeremykothe2`, #568) supplies the eight-cold family; Jonathan Capalbo (`jon314159`, #567) supplies portable identities and controls; our #572 supplies pattern/time flow expansion and the cold-replay package. The retained ancestry includes `eumemic`, `rohanarun`, `Dugongue`, `icekylinx`, `DreamingOfClouds`, `DaysSky`, `jacklightChen` and earlier contributors credited in the original notices. All 273 vendored files match their pinned Git commits. Substantial OpenAI Codex assistance was used; source-specific AI disclosures and licenses are preserved.

The all-size compiler, common-label/mutable-source realization, normalized recursive residuals, whole-call hosting, precision/tape and analytic-transfer assumptions remain, including the bit H1–H5. This is conditional finite evidence, not an unconditional multiplication theorem, complete Lean proof, practical speedup or κ = 1 result.
